name: brain-memory
description: Brain Memory — neuroscience-inspired persistent memory for AI agents. Local-first plugin (hooks + /brain:* commands over ~/.brain) and the hosted Brain Cloud MCP connector.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Local-first memory: SessionStart hook injects a budget-bounded context payload from ~/.brain, /brain:* commands cover recall, memorize, verify, pin, forget, sync, skills, import and sleep. Bundles the brain CLI.

plugins.name: brain-cloud
plugins.description: Hosted Brain Cloud MCP connector (https://mcp.brainmemory.ai/mcp) for hosts without a local ~/.brain — Claude.ai, ChatGPT desktop, mobile. OAuth 2.1 sign-in; same memories as the local plugin when synced.
